name: vrompt-coding-agent
description: One coding agent. Multiple AI models.

vrompt.modelSelection.description: Model selection mode or model identifier. Use auto for Auto — Recommended.

vrompt.codexBinary.description: Path or command name for the Codex runtime used by Vrompt app-server.

vrompt.providers.anthropic.baseUrl.description: Anthropic API base URL used by the Vrompt compatibility bridge.

vrompt.providers.anthropic.model.description: Anthropic model identifier used by Vrompt.

vrompt.providers.mistral.baseUrl.description: Mistral API base URL used by the Vrompt compatibility bridge.

vrompt.providers.mistral.model.description: Optional Mistral model override. Leave blank to use the selected Vrompt model.

vrompt.providers.zai.baseUrl.description: Z.ai API base URL. GLM Coding Plan users can set the coding endpoint instead.

vrompt.providers.zai.model.description: Optional Z.ai model override. Leave blank to use the selected Vrompt model.

vrompt.providers.google.baseUrl.description: Google Gemini OpenAI-compatible API base URL.

vrompt.providers.google.model.description: Optional Gemini model override. Leave blank to use the selected Vrompt model.

vrompt.providers.groq.model.description: Optional Groq model override. Leave blank to use the selected Vrompt model.
